<description>
**Problem:** `SelectionResult::Clear()` removes the selected inputs but keeps their bump fee discount. `GetTotalBumpFees()` then subtracts that discount from zero, so any positive discount gives the empty selection a negative fee total. The wallet currently avoids this because it only clears selections inside the knapsack solver, before applying the discount.

**Fix:** Reset the discount along with the inputs it applies to.
</description>

<commits>
dde9db3a6f test: check bump fees after clearing a selection

Reuse a selection with a known bump fee discount.
Clearing its inputs leaves the discount behind, so the empty selection reports negative bump fees.

4ce6b53149 wallet: reset the bump fee discount when clearing inputs

The discount accounts for shared ancestors of the selected inputs.
Once those inputs are gone, subtracting their discount gives the empty selection a negative bump fee total.
</commits>
